native.payload_bytes: Actual encoded text octets unknown nonnegative integer, excludes framing/signature/escaping expansion counted separately. No8/65535 default/cap; not scalar or displayed grapheme count. Selected UTF16 octets must be even and between2*scalars and4*scalars when known, even without an actual code-unit count.
native.ctxt_specification_source: Required actual application text protocol reference unknown. UTF standards define encoding, not this custom application protocol.
native.ctxt_specification_revision: Required actual text protocol revision unknown. No invented1.0 baseline or automatic compatibility.
native.ctxt_transport_binding: Required actual lower transport/interface reference unknown; no CAN/Ethernet physical default or automatic TCP message framing.
native.ctxt_encoding: Required actual UTF8/ASCII/UTF16LE/UTF16BE/OTHER. None universal for all custom protocols; selected UTF modes use RFC3629/Unicode constraints and strict scalar encoding.
native.ctxt_framing: Required actual FIXED_LENGTH/LENGTH_PREFIX/DELIMITER/TRANSPORT_MESSAGE/CONNECTION_CLOSE/CUSTOM framing unknown. Encoding alone does not delimit a stream.
native.ctxt_encoding_source: Actual encoding/normalization/invalid-input/signature contract reference unknown. OTHER requires its own specification; no locale fallback or replacement-character count guessing.
native.ctxt_layout_source: Actual application text grammar/framing/field layout unknown; actual delimiter/prefix length conventions and grammar need revision.
native.ctxt_text_value: Optional actual Unicode scalar string, not a generated default. Known UTF8/ASCII/UTF16LE/BE strictly encode and compare supplied actual payload octets/scalars/code units; rejects unpaired surrogates/ASCII nonASCII. Explicit empty string counts0. No checksum or peer decode execution proof.
native.ctxt_code_points: Actual Unicode scalar count unknown nonnegative integer, excludes separate framing signature; not grapheme count, displayed characters or UTF16 code units. ASCIIbytes=count, UTF8count<=bytes<=4count.
native.ctxt_utf16_code_units: Actual UTF16 16-bit code units unknown nonnegative integer; selected UTF16LE/BEbytes=2units, scalars<=units<=2scalars. Rejected ASCII/UTF8 to avoid treating Unicode scalars as UTF16 units.
native.ctxt_header_bytes: Actual framing header/signature bytes unknown nonnegative integer; any separately removed protocol-signature BOM counted here, content U+FEFF remains in text/payload. No automatic BOM insertion.
native.ctxt_trailer_bytes: Actual framing trailer/delimiter bytes unknown nonnegative integer, full encoded octets not scalar count. No default newline/CRLF.
native.ctxt_escape_expansion_bytes: Actual application escaping expansion unknown nonnegative integer; JSON/XML/backslash transformations can increase encoded bytes and need actual grammar.
native.ctxt_message_bytes: Actual complete encoded message unknown, exact known payload+header+trailer+escape expansion and <=known peer message limit. Not generic65535/physicalMTU cap.
native.ctxt_peer_message_limit_bytes: Actual peer accepted complete text message unknown nonnegative integer. No universal binary/TCP/CoAP byte limit borrowed.
native.ctxt_fixed_length_bytes: Actual positive complete fixed-length message bytes unknown, only FIXED_LENGTH and equals supplied complete message bytes. Not fixed number of graphemes.
native.ctxt_delimiter_hex: Actual whole-octet delimiter hex unknown nonempty, only DELIMITER. Odd hex rejected. Actual bytes differ across UTF8/UTF16; no implicit CRLF00 or escaped collision guarantee.
native.ctxt_escaping_source: Actual delimiter/character escaping grammar reference unknown. UTF8 continuation bytes/Unicode validity do not prove application framing safety.
native.ctxt_device_evidence: Actual peer encoding/buffering/timing capability reference unknown; no confirmed flag or device limit inferred from Unicode standard.

removed.qos_priority: No implicit IEEE Ethernet PCP/CAN priority for an unspecified custom text application protocol; actual lower transport owns priority.
removed.sync_method: No implicit NTP/PTP/gPTP support in a custom custom text protocol; actual timing/synchronization requires its own specification.
removed.reserved_bandwidth_percent: No universal custom text-protocol bandwidth reservation; actual underlying link/schedule evidence required.
removed.retransmission_enabled: No universal custom custom text acknowledgement/ARQ default. Actual lower transport and application retry rules must be distinguished.

removed.retransmission_delay_ms: No universal zero retry delay for unspecified custom text framing/session semantics.
